verdict.rationale: Relay issues Visa debit and credit cards, so a cashback-on-card-spend story is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence item mentions cashback or rewards on card spend, let alone automatic crediting without manual redemption. The 3.00% APY on savings and the auto-transfer rules are a different feature and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can earn automatic cashback on card spend without manual redemption steps
